summary: Following an address poisoning campaign the victim mistakenly sent 35508 USDT to an attacker controlled address that resembled a previously used recipient. The attacker converted most of the stolen funds into DAI and conducted additional successful poisoning attacks against other victims.
user_mistake: Selected a poisoned transaction history address instead of verifying the intended recipient address.
prevention: Verify the full recipient address before every transfer / Save trusted addresses in an address book
